paite: "Tu in sam in; nang hon dawng kua a-om a? Misiangthoute lak ah akua lam na nga dia?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

paite: Lungzinna in lah mihai athat a, huan thikna in mimawl athat sek hi.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

paite: Mihai zungkai ka muta a; himahleh thakhat in atenna aka hamsiat hi.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

paite: Bitna a kipan gamlapi ah atate a-om ua, kongpi ah hihgawp in a-om uh, kuamah amaute hunkhe ding a-om kei uhi.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

paite: Agilkial in ling lak a kipan nangawn a-an kaihkhawm agaihsak a, suamhat in aneih-le-lam anawmvalhsak hi.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

paite: Gimthuakna leivui a kipan in ahong pawt kei a, lei a kipan in buaina leng ahong dawnkhe sam kei hi.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

paite: Himahleh mihing buai ding mah apiang ahi, mei-ekte atoulen bang in.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

paite: "Himahleh ke'n ahihleh, Pathian lam ah ka zong ding a, Pathian kiang ah ka thu ka koih ding hi.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

paite: Thil thupite hihpa leh zonkhiak theih louh; sim zoh louh thillamdangte,
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

paite: leitung a vuah pepa leh, loute tung a tui sawlpa.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

paite: Huchi in ama'n aniamsate tungsang ah akoihtou a; misi suunte muanna ah atawisang hi.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

paite: Zekhem hatte lunggelte bangmah lou asuaksak a, huchi in akhutte un athiltup uh ahihthei kei uhi.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

paite: Mipilte akhemhatna un aman a, mihoihloute thilgel athalpaihsak hi.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

paite: Sun lai in khomialna athuak ua, zan lai bang in suntang lai in amai maimah uhi.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

paite: Himahleh ama'n gentheite mihatte kam leh khut a kipan leh tasamte mahmah namsau a kipan ahondam hi.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

paite: Huchi in mizawng in lametna anei а, thulimlouhna in akam ahumsak hi.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in abawlhoih mi in nuam asa hi; huaiziak in Bangkim hihthei sawina musit ke'n.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

paite: Ama'n lah meima abawl a, atuam a, aliamsak a, akhut in adamsak hi.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

paite: Buaina guk ah ahon suaktasak ding a; ahi, sagih ah gilou in nang ahon khoih kei ding hi.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

paite: Kial chiang in nang sihna a kipan ahon tan ding; namsau thilhihtheihna a kipan, kidou chiang in.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

paite: Kam sung a leizepna a kipan ahon sel ding a; siatna ahong tun chiang in na lau sam kei ding hi.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

paite: Siatna leh kialna ah na nui ding a, lei gamsate na kihta kei ding hi.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

paite: Gam a suangte toh na kithuahtheih ding ziak un; huan gam a gamsate nang toh na kituak ding uhi.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

paite: "Na puanin muang in a-om chih na thei ding a; na ganhuang na veh ding a, bangmah kim lou a-om kei ding hi.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

paite: Na chite leng athupi ding a, na suante lei a loupa bang in a-om ding uh chih na thei ding hi.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

paite: Kum ching in na hankhuk na zuan ding a, ahun a buhlak a-om bang in.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

paite: Ngai in, hiai thu i zongta ua, adik mah ahi, za in na hoihna ding in thei in."
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
